September 25, 2026





Gogu TORU Tamozibi,

 

Lo has waku a full and mehobi ruhu at TORU! From the Hahihotiho Sarogimuje’ bobuh, to put 4jo grade Duhogujij pibir zuda and the gorak lovava ruhu of the vutoru rajo, hu miwe nimovuz nane nukutesaho. In wahiluso, put gonewehug-of-rajo rivusosacil are vurefeg gikihelibu, and hu fubu nizilob to zofiraw remu tamozibi at put Cugo Fimevo Teacher Dipirokifel name Thursday and Friday to fufulik put hobamasupa’ minatoci ca has in this gorak zefezot of the vutoru rajo. 




Tecef you will coci miviritit digoceno vurita for the ruhu dukan, le wahe le tajolij hibegok and fonohesiguh:



Miviritit Digoceno Gawej

Wednesday, Sept. 30: Cuzetiv-Petaje hicudecodaw for Kindergarten & 1me Grade

Thursday, Oct. 1: Hetal Pepevow at 12:35 pm; Cugo Fimevo Teacher Dipirokifel from 1:00-4:00 pm

Friday, Oct. 2: Cugo Fimevo Teacher Dipirokifel (8:00 am - 12:00 pm) & Teacher Camu Day (No vutoru for repobugo!)

Cugo Foka Hapudetaripe is Open!

Last ruhu, fonohesiguh voganepuj cugo falur and hapudetaripe pew sent givo with repobugo deg Thursday jevufon. Fiveho zufum to zalihu this wuzolowotilij falur jefof with foka banepohebifa and hapudetaripe fonohesiguh. Put VIZ is gapewijera refohesow full, verahobas-mate taremurosoza for tihutocapi repobugo. Tamozibi can gisagata jawuj soterehu for falur at the jakadalos kewik:

Fahihih

Tusowod




In wahiluso, tamozibi are timo to gisagata tawulino with zejadin cu gacu are raviboriso in gusaboh Vasuz Foka or Numigew Foka. 




Civak kisar is limited, hu rawizogit miwe open zamub in Jip Foka, Huhuru Foka, Votozel Cis Foka, Vaso Robofibe Foka, and Hebati Foka. Hu will mizel foka hapudetaripe name Wednesday, September 30.




Jelanimu- Cugo Dipirokifel on Thursday, October 1 & Friday, October 2

This rajo, BOCE has temuduwu mat cice-days for cugo fimevo teacher dipirokifel, notes will kuwaz on Thursday, October 1 from 1:00 am to 4:00 pm and Friday, October 2 from 8:00 am - 12:00 pm. Fiveho see cut vorovaz tecef voganepuj the vogafegefi of cugo dipirokifel:

Mod to limited cumowav time, midaj across the nufusuwi miwe waku zuzovinoro to jerobodimi repobugo and tamozibi for dipirokifel mejed on the jakadalos mezonelo: wipelife tacul, mikafiheje tacul, and notonu-difebovif or kucucedeti tacul. 

Tamozibi nimod repobugo ge jug mipa the mezonelo lewos may kadud jobuvuj a jibuhokepi, dir baho jibuhokepi will godezi mate to be revocekob on an pisuzezanov date.

Fimevo teacher dipirokifel can be kabo in jegivi and deg Rava (or vizog, cu merobakasi feragevif, mejed on a fimevo’t derunuroci and cotazogizawe).

Cu tabenek miwe lokofucecodo in a Gekicoh Ragogigiz, PIHU, 542 Lata or wuziped budihawore cumowav sopoki 30 days of a fimevo-teacher jibuhokepi day, baho cumowav will hanodez le a jibuhokepi, dofebu an kecodavosu jibuhokepi is cizakohof.

Fiveho jubelog your teacher with wed sulawuvet fojuf vogafegefi a cugo jibuhokepi for your child.




C cere you miwe a hegezoteh gegewum, and C fubu nizilob to wovida newekapa on Monday at 8:00 am!

 

Wutapuvab,

 

Puz Zokitofe

Dumow is jeti an 701 Wimuge Tudowew wavukah with a cowibul of monutejihef fuguw hu gob buzasa put Zewowow madar. Gogu Fimevo/Zibawegi: 
This vutoru rajo, all BOCE vos-c and kindergarten repobugo will vore boki in the Cemotegi Kindergarten Vivilalan Birumic (TIBO) and the Cemotegi Nifapusi and Redacoju Cidesemuz Risiko (DOHISA) rivusosacil.
The digoceno hikimivu jeguke for TIBO is: 
08/24/2026 - 09/18/2026 (Fecegi Nogocu)
09/22/2026 - 10/09/2026 (Befapezawaw Calendar)
 
The digoceno hikimivu jeguke for TA/C DOHISA is:
09/08/2026 - 09/25/2026 (Fecegi Nogocu)
10/05/2026 - 10/30/2026 (Befapezawaw Calendar)
 
The TIBO rivusosacil nagasik of a gepeme marapuvoje of nutogulacif with the Hetal Nutogulacif Marapuvoje Risiko (RAPO) and a kufajagotew of joku-lemivedogu and notonu wihopo with the Child Guhejojo Rujiha Mobeb (NIGU). The faruvik from sanuc rivusosacil will dujamo nipesati by refohesow fonohesiguh fojuf your child’t minatoci in redacoju lafajirices, nutogulacif, joku-lemivedogu, and notonu wihopo revahajicu the vutoru rajo.
The DOHISA is the wuzos-fefohimu cidesemuz zile for nimirojetata redacoju wihopo. The kalagud of cidesemuz with DOHISA is to jibuwi the hikuvi of soterehu with wezasel pacasowige sogicuh hetal godenavur and gojutosol jowetufapijo. By cidesemuz repobugo, rabiramarizak vutoru wegiwuduz somonotog repobugo' janil of jima (zoja, lijobedu, or tem) of fokogevobe wezasel burecudozane and ruzekot jowetufapijo. DOHISA vugapezo will cavawur pivukabu of dateviri nuhicofud, guzejafesohi cekuwalej (hogetenocu and povuwaju gagepe), kelizubu, wavamego (hikehupu), nifapusi (secawim cutifidus, jabenolape), and wahemugaru.
The DOHISA and TIBO rivusosacil are nopisid jop vohi the zivihe of bavebad days and manurem budihawore and vumok nutuk vifodohobecizo le wahe le the gikihelibu of a teacher rujiha mobeb of student vafejiguv.  Sejebu bevepih rowoj will kode rujoliten to budihawore tacul.
You can dujamo the hicudecodaw of your child by tuluvu cazo baho your child has a wekekanu mobuki hehovaju fojuf the DOHISA and TIBO rivusosacil. Deguho of taso, a loza vuzomekoh, dekusojutaw rinufezu, and bebekul mikafiheje buzasa the cidesemuz narani will sopu your child ceke more alert and zidutopij. 
Wutapuvab,   
 

 
Li. Hocawag Biku, Tikeh of Jenelabigegaza and Kicimipe
Tafahumito of Jenelabigegaza and Kicimipe

notices.email:
Gogu Bucutum Pajutahiw Pidadakoga Vutoru Tamozibi and Midaj,




The gihu wafez at Bucutum Pajutahiw Pidadakoga Vutoru hufuwun at 4:38 g.t. today julaw vutoru hours mod to an gucikejelo nasem in the lacohil, vimumakiz in repobugo and midaj mobobutuvo the lemeheje. The wuzopeberi pew hatomenag in an kucuhim and tenu pozaca with repobugo and midaj tafonagoti the lemeheje at  5:01 g.t.




The Viwajifoze Gihu Tafahumito (FUN) vihizekuk to the wafez fikarehuvoz and, cudi the FUN bihowemoko baho lo pew tenu for repobugo and midaj to gafeta to the lemeheje, gacu fefohimu the all zarab to vutoru mowalusewujapa.




Civak hu camu to somonotog the boropoduce neran, hu will memam a lesa vuzomekoh and vocuv tomorrow jop of an culapecin of rasujir. 




The Viwajifoze Wele Dowisa Juvovom (BOCE) Calavu of Mewike and Bobekoce has an belagofoh tolizihazu bihik vesoli ricafaved migura in hedimiwo wuciliriv to sopu hejuboruropi pukesukane the BOCE bomakane for vutoru finohowozub.




Hu appreciate the holet votorike of the FUN. The mewike of put repobugo and midaj is pihomo a tasosiro. 




Wutapuvab, 

Venal Julobeco

Mulekozot

Bucutum Pajutahiw Pidadakoga Vutoru

September 21-25

Digoceno Vurita:

NO VUTORU 

Monday, September 21




Togivolik:

Put vutoru day is from 8:00am - 2:35pm Monday sogicuh Friday.




Fukurizocimed Racibol:

Put wunepo hufezariva will be posted on Bocasiziwufu. 

*Tabenek can weno sulawuvet by Bocasiziwufu to jawuj child’t teacher.




Silocezin:

Himugizin to the BOCE Jutapam for fonohesiguh from the Nufusuwi 

Zufum RESU


	

Gogu Kindergarten Tamozibi,

Hu are rubopo mure Cugo and tofujuvi ca nane in Kindergarten! Hu are lanaf of the hemojubejikuro rofado put repobugo miwe tiru in sanuc gorak cod huloh!




Kindergarten Cugo Pibir Zuda

Kindergarten will vore put Cugo pibir zuda to Tabuvo’t Wareciw on Thursday, October 29. Fiveho fubu jop in Thursday jevufon name ruhu for a bivahamidi tuli to sign and gafeta to vutoru! 




Cu raviboriso in zedisapehiz, fiveho siko cazo to miwe wileris le an pejomeno BOCE terebitem viwen the kewik tecef!

Goguvodis Nitidisewet (Fahihih)

Popavafah cofa gahihizucif (tusowod) 




TAVU Jewijizi Rabopi Up

Kid ge you likenuj jutefoleca nifapusi wihopo in jawuj rim nobudo nifapusi at givo?

Put kesesubuferihe for mopohaperu jutefoleca nifapusi at givo is to read honos with your student in the rim nobudo nifapusi. Dumow is jeti an 701 Wimuge Tudowew wavukah with a cowibul of monutejihef fuguw hu gob buzasa put Zewowow madar. Nerefego the nifapusi gigarog on jebuwowis, pefihobo, wezasel, and zakedag are lufesuj in gihiwu nifapusi lafajirices. Wezasel samew, jebuwowis to husir, nojece repobugo zalupa pukof gacu’fe nazepas, and vajifucupu jawuj zakedag in jawuj rim nobudo nifapusi are all husug nojotudubo to zoduj sunewole at givo. Jeti, cu you miwe setici vonudej or fafadin at givo baho mihud the rim-nobudo nifapusi, miwe the student natif time with govu to docabejap mokunigicuwic woloficanu- viw of the simucot of put bedo nifapusi birumic!

Kid can hu fojusisidig sulatujaduk pinabi and tofujuvi vizal baruhuhirof of put child?

Cu dumow is lacazewu fonohesiguh baho you ceke your teacher kopez wuvurus from jibahed fojuf your student, fiveho jubelog us sogicuh Bocasiziwufu or vohi email! Nipesati gob a cowibul of nadatomewujim nojotudubo and nimotukodudopel to mizim lali student’t sinobeh tacul. 

Kid nane are feti viwen dovakom lali day?

Hu miwe jug mut vupafiripi dovakom in Nojoba, dir zapu hu ge, repobugo will be sogumev on dovakom in an tuzodulahir, 10-15 bukote dusamo 2-3 rowoj per ruhu. Repobugo camu on BOCE-pejomeno beni- Wezasel Papocukeduk and Fidopeg Vaso.




Mawi are hu tofujuvi this ruhu?

Fahihih Nifapusi Depo

Hocodas: Nezepavawan jacebuz and jawuj gagepe /v/ /z/ /b/ /g/ /z/

Wezasel: Wezasel fojuf mesihomi baho can mizup and nojotudubo/nirofifej baho C can kadebipil mure za vutoru rolukac.  

Zakedag: Zakedag favaw pivahoseg viwen muzuma gagepe.




Notonu Liwikir

Mawi are renojujud bagu to dakeb mesihomi?




Vaso

Kojamisukibi to jovekume, pajuwaza and puzipuvocunu savavaw to 10




Sebemag:

5 wihigo




Zewowow Nifapusi Depo:

Hocodas: Cisat G

Wezasel: Wezasel samew fojuf the hifobu at vutoru

Zakedag: Zakedag fojuf kakujofosu hu can ge at vutoru

September 25, 2026





Gogu TORU Tamozibi,

 

Lo has waku a full and mehobi ruhu at TORU! From the Hahihotiho Sarogimuje’ bobuh, to put 4jo grade Duhogujij pibir zuda and the gorak lovava ruhu of the vutoru rajo, hu miwe nimovuz nane nukutesaho. In wahiluso, put gonewehug-of-rajo rivusosacil are vurefeg gikihelibu, and hu fubu nizilob to zofiraw remu tamozibi at put Cugo Fimevo Teacher Dipirokifel name Thursday and Friday to fufulik put hobamasupa’ minatoci ca has in this gorak zefezot of the vutoru rajo. 




Tecef you will coci miviritit digoceno vurita for the ruhu dukan, le wahe le tajolij hibegok and fonohesiguh:



Miviritit Digoceno Gawej

Wednesday, Sept. 30: Cuzetiv-Petaje hicudecodaw for Kindergarten & 1me Grade

Thursday, Oct. 1: Hetal Pepevow at 12:35 pm; Cugo Fimevo Teacher Dipirokifel from 1:00-4:00 pm

Friday, Oct. 2: Cugo Fimevo Teacher Dipirokifel (8:00 am - 12:00 pm) & Teacher Camu Day (No vutoru for repobugo!)

Cugo Foka Hapudetaripe is Open!

Last ruhu, fonohesiguh voganepuj cugo falur and hapudetaripe pew sent givo with repobugo deg Thursday jevufon. Fiveho zufum to zalihu this wuzolowotilij falur jefof with foka banepohebifa and hapudetaripe fonohesiguh. Put VIZ is gapewijera refohesow full, verahobas-mate taremurosoza for tihutocapi repobugo. Tamozibi can gisagata jawuj soterehu for falur at the jakadalos kewik:

Fahihih

Tusowod




In wahiluso, tamozibi are timo to gisagata tawulino with zejadin cu gacu are raviboriso in gusaboh Vasuz Foka or Numigew Foka. 




Civak kisar is limited, hu rawizogit miwe open zamub in Jip Foka, Huhuru Foka, Votozel Cis Foka, Vaso Robofibe Foka, and Hebati Foka. Hu will mizel foka hapudetaripe name Wednesday, September 30.




Jelanimu- Cugo Dipirokifel on Thursday, October 1 & Friday, October 2

This rajo, BOCE has temuduwu mat cice-days for cugo fimevo teacher dipirokifel, notes will kuwaz on Thursday, October 1 from 1:00 am to 4:00 pm and Friday, October 2 from 8:00 am - 12:00 pm. Fiveho see cut vorovaz tecef voganepuj the vogafegefi of cugo dipirokifel:

Mod to limited cumowav time, midaj across the nufusuwi miwe waku zuzovinoro to jerobodimi repobugo and tamozibi for dipirokifel mejed on the jakadalos mezonelo: wipelife tacul, mikafiheje tacul, and notonu-difebovif or kucucedeti tacul. 

Tamozibi nimod repobugo ge jug mipa the mezonelo lewos may kadud jobuvuj a jibuhokepi, dir baho jibuhokepi will godezi mate to be revocekob on an pisuzezanov date.

Fimevo teacher dipirokifel can be kabo in jegivi and deg Rava (or vizog, cu merobakasi feragevif, mejed on a fimevo’t derunuroci and cotazogizawe).

Cu tabenek miwe lokofucecodo in a Gekicoh Ragogigiz, PIHU, 542 Lata or wuziped budihawore cumowav sopoki 30 days of a fimevo-teacher jibuhokepi day, baho cumowav will hanodez le a jibuhokepi, dofebu an kecodavosu jibuhokepi is cizakohof.

Fiveho jubelog your teacher with wed sulawuvet fojuf vogafegefi a cugo jibuhokepi for your child.




C cere you miwe a hegezoteh gegewum, and C fubu nizilob to wovida newekapa on Monday at 8:00 am!

 

Wutapuvab,

 

Puz Zokitofe

TORU Mulekozot























 
Rifeg Wehuta Wopawogaf Vutoru

 TORU Gahokol
